parole.testo: Borrowed from Karakhanid اَذْرِمْ (eδrim, “saddlecloth”). Compare Ottoman Turkish ایریم (eyrim, “saddlecloth”).

parole.significato: horn of narwhal, walrus and certain such animals
parole.testo: Tenth century, via Karakhanid خُتُو (χutū) from Middle Chinese 骨咄 (MC kwot twot|twat), from Khitan 榾柮犀 (MC kwot twot|dzwat sej) recorded in the History of Liao.
